focus_area_title: Clarify How Individual Tasks Support Company Goals
content_text_body:
Achieving individual goals is a great way for team members to help reach company goals. The objective is to help your team understand that what they are working on as an individual will make a positive difference for the team, organization, and company. 

 

 

 

 ### Align work to high-level goals

 

 List upcoming tasks that you'll need to delegate to your team. Think of the bigger picture goals or outcomes that each task will achieve. Write out a statement that explains how the task will contribute to the company's future goals. Use words like: change, impact, affect, and goal. 

 

 

 

 ### Reinforce business impacts

 

 When your team members agree to take on important tasks, frame your appreciation in terms of the impact they have: "Thank you for committing to doing X, it will help us achieve Y and that's really important for the business because of Z.â€
